cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 81% of AI names green
cards.body: SPX +0.62% · BTC -0.09% · Gold +1.35% · Nasdaq100 +1.19%. At the last close, 81% of 101 AI names were green — a broad bid. AI Applications & Data Software did the heavy lifting at +6.72%.

cards.headline: AI Applications & Data Software leads, AI Platforms, Internet & AdTech lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is AI Applications & Data Software at +6.72%; weakest is AI Platforms, Internet & AdTech at +0.13%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: PUBM is the standout at +31.90%
cards.body: Leaders: PUBM +31.90%, SPCX +15.83%, OKLO +14.77%, SOUN +13.28%, DV +12.81%. Laggards: TTD -21.90%, INOD -4.81%, SKHY -3.92%, ANET -1.90%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) +15.83% at $133.11
cards.body: The SpaceX debut keeps pulling attention — SPCX is +15.83% this session. The biggest IPO in history remains the tape's attention magnet.

cards.headline: TTD moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: TTD is -21.90% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 49 — Neutral
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 49/100, led by Valuation at 85. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
